statement:
{X} [NormedField X] [LinearOrder X] [IsStrictOrderedRing X] [FloorSemiring X] (a : ℕ → X) (ha : ¬UnBddPeaks a) :
  ∃ σ, Subseq σ ∧ Monotone (a ∘ σ)
name: MonotoneSubseq_of_BddPeaks
content: If a sequence `a : ℕ → X` (where `X` could be `ℚ` or `ℝ`) does not have unbounded peaks, then it has a `Monotone` subsequence.
